scripts.docker:local:setup: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up --build -d && sh -c 'until curl -fsS http://localhost:5173/ >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml exec -T app node ./scripts/seed-sqlite.mjs
scripts.docker:local:reseed: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml down && npm run db:local:reset && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d && sh -c 'until curl -fsS http://localhost:5173/ >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml exec -T app node ./scripts/seed-sqlite.mjs
